entries.t: <FACE:6F>Hah! Hah!<NL><WAIT>I've still got a ways<NL>to go! More training!<WAIT>Hah! Hah!
<FACE:6C>Perfect timing!<NL>My training paid off…<WAIT>Let me show you!
<FACE:6D>Gwaaah!<NL>Beaten again!<WAIT>Still a long way to go<NL>Back to training!
<FACE:00>Why are you here? You<NL>went to Jupiter, no?
<FACE:6C>I am going!<NL><WAIT>But I'm not ready yet!<NL>Not enough training!
<FACE:04>You don't have to do<NL>it right here…
<FACE:6D>Gravity in the hideout<NL>is too weak to train!<WAIT><FACE:00>Oh, I see…
